Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner switched to comparing the directors’ ages at the time of each film’s release instead of comparing their actual ages/birth years as the task requires. Since A. B. Raj (1925/1929–2020) is older than Amos Kollek (born 1947) regardless of the 1925 vs 1929 ambiguity, the correct film with the younger director is A Couch in New York. The methodological shift led to the wrong conclusion (Kalippava).
